pr_title: roachtest: report failures to extend cluster as infra flakes
pr_body:
This commit introduces two main changes:

* always verify if we need to extend a cluster's lifetime before running a test, whether the cluster is being reused or not;
* if we fail to extend the cluster's lifetime, report the error as an infrastructure flake (cluster creation error). Crucially, don't return an error to the worker (which would halt the entire run), and don't notify teams about the failure.

Fixes: #115950.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/116387)

Running `weekly/tpcc/headroom` on this branch now extends the cluster's lifetime based on the test's timeout:

```
20:36:02 cluster.go:2624: [w0] extending cluster by 95h2m36.872499955s
```

Also running a `SELEC_PROBABILITY=0.1` build:

https://teamcity.cockroachdb.com/viewQueued.html?itemId=13127705&tab=queuedBuildOverviewTab

Failures on the build are unrelated.

TFTRs!
